Draw one mirror-plot panel (query up, reference down)

plot_mirror.Rd

Draw one mirror-plot panel (query up, reference down)

Usage

plot_mirror(
  df,
  xlim_range = NULL,
  title = "",
  precursor_mz = NULL,
  mz_digits = 1,
  mz_label_mode = "all"
)

Arguments

df

Data frame from build_mirror_df()

xlim_range

Length-2 numeric or NULL

title

Panel title

precursor_mz

Numeric scalar or NULL

mz_digits

Integer

mz_label_mode

One of "all", "primary", "adduct"

Value

A ggplot object
